newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-KOEMAN HOPING BARCELONA WILL MARK HIS FAREWELL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KOEMAN HOPING BARCELONA WILL MARK HIS FAREWELL.

text.p: Former Dutch international defender Ronald Koeman is hoping his old club Barcelona will play his current side Feyenoord in the farewell match to mark his retirement in August.

Koeman, who will be 34 next month, is retiring at the end of this season after a glittering career highlighted by European Cup wins with PSV Eindhoven in 1988 and Barcelona in 1992 and the European Championship with the Netherlands in 1988.
Barcelona have said they are keen to play in the match but would make a final decision when they know what their opening fixtures are for next season.
